name: Hard season
job: answers: what comes first when things are hard, with the rest paused

unlock.text: Always; the suggestion appears when a debt weighs 4 or more or a shock leaves under three months.

coreChanges: core change: the result screen pauses the optimizer sections and What's next shows stability items only while hard season is on (ui/screens/result.ts, ui/screens/next.ts, decision A15)

killCriteria.measure: share of people who turn it on after the suggestion, and turn it off again within 90 days
killCriteria.action: keep the suggestion as a flag and drop the mode
